gamefaqs.section: PlayStation 2 PS3 Virtual Memory Card Save (ZIP) (North America)

format: PS3 Virtual Memory Card export (.PSV): '\0VSP' header, PS2 save type 2, 36680 bytes, folder BASLUS-20712, 3 files, 36340 bytes of file data

title: GRADIUS V
SAVE DATA
save.times: as the file stores them (PS2 card times, JST)

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/ps2-card.py 'GRADIUS V/BASLUS-20712.PSV' -o OUT: reads the save with mymcplus 3.0.5 and writes OUT/Mcd001.ps2 (an 8 MiB card with ECC, formatted and filled by mymcplus) for lrps2/pcee2/pcsx2, and OUT/mc0/<folder>/ for Play!

converted.read_back: work/ps2/tools/mcfs.py lists every file with the size and SHA-1 put on the card; one-saves (1saves convert + inspect) reads the card and finds BASLUS-20712
converted.timestamps: what the save does not date is 2000-01-01 00:00:00 (JST, as a card stores it); the card's own root entries too

pcee2.detail: menu reads FREE PLAY (no save: CREDIT 3); STAGE SELECT offers stages 1-8 of loop 1 (no save: stage 1); RANKING (VERY EASY) KON 127000 1-2 on top of the default table
